说明: 外部性状数据库的固定版本。只在开发时下载（npm run data:fetch），运行时不联网（铁律 6）。sha256 在第一次下载后用 --pin 填入，之后内容变了会报警。dir 为 external 的文件进仓库（许可允许再分发，需署名，见 data-external/README.md），raw 的不进仓库。两个库的许可都在 2026-10-13 从官网核实过：PanTHERIA 是 CC BY 4.0，AnAge 是 CC BY 3.0，都允许再分发。

sources.name: PanTHERIA 1.0（MSW05 分类）
sources.citation: Jones, K.E. et al. (2009) PanTHERIA: a species-level database of life history, ecology, and geography of extant and recently extinct mammals. Ecology 90:2648. Ecological Archives E090-184.
sources.license: CC BY 4.0。ESA Ecological Archives 版权页："Except where otherwise noted, Ecological Archives are covered under the Creative Commons Attribution (CC BY 4.0) license."。整份文件放进仓库，署名见 data-external/README.md。

sources.name: AnAge: The Animal Ageing and Longevity Database
sources.citation: Tacutu, R. et al. (2018) Human Ageing Genomic Resources: new and updated databases. Nucleic Acids Research 46:D1083–D1090. 另见 de Magalhães, J. P. et al. (2024) Nucleic Acids Research 52(D1):D900–D908.
sources.license: CC BY 3.0。HAGR 版权页（legal.html）："HAGR may be freely used for all purposes … provided you mention the use of HAGR"，页面标注 Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported。整份 zip 与解压后的数据放进仓库，署名见 data-external/README.md。
